# Vendored front-end libraries

Local copies so the web UI works fully offline (`SAMPLE_MODE=true`, Docker with `--network none`).

| File | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `3Dmol-min.js` | 2.4.2 | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/3Dmol/2.4.2/3Dmol-min.js | BSD-3-Clause |
| `mermaid.min.js` | 11.17.2 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.17.2/dist/mermaid.min.js | MIT |
| `fonts/*.woff2`, `fonts/fonts.css` | IBM Plex Sans, Serif, Mono (latin, latin-ext, greek) | Google Fonts | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

To update, download the new version to the same path and change the version in this table.
